name: Pseudo-Volume Noise Compositing
definition: A procedural noise generation technique that composites four layered noise samples over a pseudo-3D position field, applies a multiplicative cell mask, and combines them to produce a volumetric-like texture output.
summary: Pseudo-Volume Noise Compositing synthesizes volumetric textures by compositing four noise layers over a pseudo-3D position field, using tiled cell indexing and multiplicative masking to simulate volume boundaries.
